audit_result.proof_trace: The application enforces only `supabase_auth_user_id` uniqueness (L244-253, filtered by `deleted_at IS NULL`), not `discord_uid` uniqueness. After a soft-delete (`deleteMember` sets `deleted_at`, L551), the same Discord/Supabase user can re-register because the guard finds no active row, and L284 inserts a new row with the identical `discord_uid`. No SQL migrations exist in the repository to confirm a DB-level UNIQUE constraint on `discord_uid`.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Admin soft-deletes member X → member X logs in via Discord OAuth → arrives at /dashboard/register → passes the `supabase_auth_user_id` guard (deleted row excluded by `is('deleted_at', null)`) → `registerNewMember` inserts a new row with the same `discord_uid`; if no DB UNIQUE constraint exists, a duplicate row is created causing undefined behaviour in Discord role/nickname sync.

PROP-e5782b58-inv-014.text: Discord_id must be unique across members.users; duplicate discord_id registration must be rejected.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-014.assertion: forall INSERT into members.users: UNIQUE(discord_id) constraint enforced
